question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to **“disappointing”**.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"disappointing"** refers to something that does not meet expectations or causes dissatisfaction. (निराशाजनक)
 
 
• **Example:** The performance of the team was disappointing as they failed to win any matches.
 
 
• **"Satisfying"** means something that fulfills expectations or brings pleasure and contentment. (संतोषजनक)
 
 
• **Example:** The meal was satisfying, and everyone enjoyed it immensely.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"disappointing"** is **"satisfying"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Satisfying**.

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frustrating** (चिड़चिड़ाहट पैदा करने वाला): Causing annoyance or irritation due to challenges or lack of progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The delay in receiving the results was frustrating for the students.
 
 
 
• **Discouraging** (हतोत्साहित करने वाला): Something that causes loss of confidence or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** The constant failures were discouraging, but she refused to give up.
 
 
 
• **Underwhelming** (अप्रभावी): Not meeting expectations or being unimpressive.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was underwhelming despite the hype around it.
 
 

209:T87d,

The correct answer is** option 4.**
